issues.title: Missing GWT for core pipeline logic
issues.why: While structural ACs (AC-01 to AC-08) are robust, the actual logic for SHA-deduplication, vulnerability filtering, and matrix aggregation lacks GWT criteria.
issues.fix: Add GWT criteria to 97-acceptance-criteria.md for SHA-cache hit/miss behavior and stdlib vs third-party vuln exit codes.

issues.title: Race condition in SHA cache saving
issues.why: The spec notes inlining cache writes to prevent races but doesn't specify behavior if the 'final validation job' is skipped via step-conditionals.
issues.fix: Explicitly define that the cache-save step must only execute if all previous validation steps in that job were successful and not skipped.

issues.title: Ambiguous binary naming placeholders
issues.why: The build command uses <binary> and <module> placeholders without a defined source (e.g., from go.mod or a specific env var).
issues.fix: Pin the source of the binary name to the 'binary_name' property defined in the Technical Interface JSON schema.
